function: Excluded (above_phy): PPO learns UAV placement, the AR rendering (task offloading) decision and block-producer selection; bandwidth and computing allocation is solved by a non-learned Lagrangian method (p. 7).
notes: Excluded, above_phy. p. 7: the PPO action space comprises "the UAV location, the block producer decision, and the rendering decision", that is UAV placement and task offloading, both above the physical layer. Bandwidth and computing allocation (CBRA) is solved by the non-learned LMI algorithm (p. 7, Algorithm 1 on p. 8), and p. 12 says the LMI "reduces the decision space" of the DRL. No learned MIMO, RIS or other physical-layer function. PDF title and DOI match on p. 1.
